description: The line plot, titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," illustrates the relationship between accuracy (measured as Pass@8) and temperature for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," spans from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, also on a linear scale. The On-policy RL method is represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, which shows a general increasing trend, starting at approximately 64.5 at a temperature of 0.1 and rising to about 73.5 at a temperature of 1.0, with a notable peak around 0.8. The LUFFY method is depicted by a red line with star markers, which exhibits a more complex pattern, starting at 75.5, peaking at 80.0 at a temperature of 0.8, and ending at approximately 80.5 at a temperature of 1.0. The SFT method is shown as a dark teal line with triangle markers, starting at 75.5, decreasing to a low of 70.0 at a temperature of 0.5, and then rising again to about 74.5 at a temperature of 1.0.
